implementation_notes.note: BUG-437 optimization design: keep official offline data source, 2018-08-01~2026-04-30 window, single cache semantics, fail-fast resource gates, and no full 575-factor recompute before user approval. Primary optimization path is bounded in-batch metric buffering plus adaptive effective workers, with runtime validation recording requested/effective workers, metric-buffer peak, and resource gates. Tests added to allowed scope for regression coverage.

Implemented design target: official full compute keeps existing data source/window/cache semantics, but moves independent metric calculation into the factor worker when metrics context is available. Parent process persists parquet/meta/DB metrics and records metric_precomputed, metric_parent_computed, metric_precompute_failures, requested/effective workers in runtime_validation.optimization_profile. Worker metric errors emit metric_precompute_fallback and are recomputed by parent, so performance fallback is explicit and auditable rather than silent.
